current.text: Milwaukee lost two frontcourt players, Giannis Antetokounmpo (traded to Miami) and Bobby Portis.
The frontcourt departures should give him more minutes.
Power forward is Milwaukee's weakest position, and he is one of the weak options there.

He could start at the four, but the expert's projected starters are Rollins, Herro, Jaquez, Ware and Turner, and the team will likely start a center at power forward. His starting role is not settled.
Ranked around 194 on Yahoo and 223 on ESPN with no auction value, he is outside the 144 players drafted in our league.

durable.text: He was hyped early in his career but became a mediocre role player.
His category profile has no strong category. Blocks are his weakest category, but they are not a real outlier.

note: Kuzma is not a draft target for us. Yahoo ranks him 194 and ESPN 223, both give him 0 USD of value, and none of his categories stands out. His projections are close to average everywhere (about 14 points, 5 rebounds and 1.4 threes), so he fills a slot without fitting any particular build. Watch early on whether coach Taylor Jenkins starts him at power forward in place of a two-center lineup. If he starts and gets more than the 26 minutes he played last season, he is a cheap waiver pickup for bulk points and rebounds.
